about_short_description.short_description: Geneva is an online home for groups, clubs, and communities of all shapes and sizes.

product.name: Geneva Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for groups, clubs, and communities to communicate and organize through chat, voice, video, and forum rooms.

product.name: Forum Rooms
product.description: A feature within Geneva that enables communities to share long-form content and collaborate asynchronously with text formatting and post management.

product.name: Member Groups
product.description: A feature that allows grouping of members into cohorts to manage access and permissions within a Geneva community.

product.name: Event Scheduling and Management
product.description: Tools within Geneva for creating, scheduling, and managing community events, including digital and in-person gatherings.

product.name: Membership API and Integrations
product.description: An API and integration system that connects Geneva community membership with external systems for automated access management.

product.name: Decisions Under Fire
product.description: A first-person Unreal Engine 5 simulator that trains soldiers in international humanitarian law and combat decision-making through interactive missions.
